Agents.Title: Agents
Agents.Subtitle: Coding CLIs Kam can hand work to, and role agents it started.
Agents.SubtitleTip: An agent is instructions, a model, tools and a permission mode. Kam creates role agents for a task on its own and can hand coding work to Codex. Saved agents you configure yourself are coming next.
Agents.Empty.Body: No role agents yet. They show up when a task delegates work to one, such as a reviewer.
Agents.Detail.NoOutput: This run has not produced an answer.
Agents.Cli.Codex.About: OpenAI's coding agent for your terminal. Kam can hand it a coding task and shows you the whole brief before anything runs.
Agents.Cli.Claude.About: Anthropic's coding agent for your terminal. Kam detects it but does not hand tasks to it yet.
